snippet.title: Season of Enchantment Trailer | Sky: Children of the Light
snippet.description:
From today, fans of Sky will be able to dive into ’Season of Enchantment’, which promises to be the most impactful adventure arc in the series so far.  As a mysterious boat rows into dusk, its eerie invitation lures the sky children towards an abandoned ship in the Golden Wasteland. 

Sky is available on the iOS App Store: http://bit.ly/PlaySkyiOS
Sky on Google Play will launch in April 2020: http://bit.ly/PreregisterSky
It is announced for Nintendo Switch in 2020: https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/sky-children-of-the-light-switch/

Visit our website thatskygame.com, and stay tuned for more news via our social media:
